searchText: I dunno. I haven't tried in ages, but the article series from Piper (https://snakecharmers.ethereum.org/the-winding-road-to-functional-light-clients/) spells to me that the LES protocol is practically broken. or at best unsuitable for production. asking bc I want to convince a project to use ENS resolution, but they need to be trustless and thus can't rely on Infura. <@!451873750502342686> They can run their own LES infrastructure, dedicated full nodes to serve their light clients. Development of the networking infrastructure (portal clients) outlined in that blog post series is underway but likely not ready for real use cases for 12 months or so...
